items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-27
items.q: he had, uh, Nigel Lane, a trombone

ctx.x: for dear and a little c-sopran, a little curve one, see? Onto the bass saxophone, and all the guys in the band were playing saxophone at one time. You know, because he was selling instruments and stuff.

Because he was selling instruments and stuff like that, that's how he got with the con coming in, and we got the whirline, see, and he had, I think, I think the kind of instrument he was selling, couturier horns and cornets and all. Oh incidentally, I forgot to tell you about Tony Amaricka, I used to go to school with him too. Oh really? Yeah, St. Louis College, you know, and I sold him his first conet when I was working at Whirline, see, and I mean, he was there when I was with Zig Benore and all, you know, we…
What about Armand, Hug? When did you first meet him?
